title: The Great Frozen Sea: A Personal Narrative of the Voyage of the "Alert"

As the expedition sets sail, initial encounters with inclement weather and heavy seas evoke a sense of anticipation and uncertainty about the voyage ahead, hinting at the grueling experiences that lie in wait amidst the vast, frozen wilderness.
